title: Shapes all around us
examples: Teacher, what shape is a clock face?
Can you show me a square thing in the classroom?

explain.say: Look around you. Can you see any circles?
Now look for squares. A square has four equal sides.
Next, find triangles. A triangle has three straight sides.
Last, look for rectangles. A rectangle has two long sides and two short sides.
Think about a door. A door is usually a rectangle.
A circle has no corners. Wheels are circles, so they roll.

faq.q: How many sides does a square have?
faq.a: A square has four straight sides.
asks: What is the shape of a square?
How many sides does it have?

faq.q: Are all circles the same size?
faq.a: No. Circles can be big or small.
asks: Do all circles look the same?
Is there a size limit for a circle?

faq.q: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?
faq.a: A square is a special rectangle. All four of its sides are the same length.
asks: Do they have to be the same size?

faq.q: Can a triangle have sides of different lengths?
faq.a: Yes. A triangle can have sides of different lengths.
A ball is a sphere. From every side, it looks like a circle.

facts: A circle has no straight sides or corners.
A square has four sides that are all the same length.
A triangle has exactly three straight sides.
A rectangle has four sides, with opposite sides being equal.

quiz.say: Look at the door. What shape is it?
quiz.why: A door has two long sides and two short sides.

wrong.0: A circle is round, and a door has straight sides.
wrong.2: A triangle has three sides, and a door has four.

quiz.say: Join three straight lines. What shape do you make?
quiz.why: Three straight sides make a triangle.

wrong.0: A square needs four straight lines.
wrong.1: A circle is made with one round line.

quiz.say: Which shape has two long sides and two short sides?
quiz.why: A rectangle has two long sides and two short sides.

wrong.1: A square has four sides that are all the same length.
